about: Named type sets for use_theme(typeset=...). Roles: display (titles, cover, big numbers), text (body, boxes, chips, chart labels). The theme's main font (handwriting by default) stays loaded for hand() notes; ui_font sets digits, axes and subtitles. Faces with a file are loaded from assets/ and checked before rendering; families without one are system fonts, named as on macOS; Windows and Linux get stand-ins (微软雅黑、宋体).

hand.name: 手写（默认）
hand.desc: 全片霞鹜文楷，数字和刻度用苹方（Windows 上是微软雅黑）

heavy.name: 粗黑
heavy.desc: 系统最粗的黑体标题 + 中粗正文，手写只留给批注

song.name: 宋体
song.desc: 宋体粗标题 + 苹方正文，书卷气

kai.name: 文楷
kai.desc: 霞鹜文楷（常用字子集）标题和正文，温和好读

smiley.name: 得意黑
smiley.desc: 得意黑斜体标题 + 苹方中粗正文，海报和短视频感

clean.name: 苹方
clean.desc: 标题正文都用苹方，干净的界面感

lab.name: 细黑
lab.desc: 苹方中粗标题 + 苹方常规正文，字重轻、留白多：产品发布会的克制

serif.name: 细宋
serif.desc: 宋体细体标题 + 苹方细体正文，字距放开：电影字幕和书封的安静
